subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: The length of a rectangle is 10 cm and its breadth is 8 cm. What is its area?
solution: Area of rectangle = length * breadth = 10 * 8 = 80 sq cm. Topic (Mensuration) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
